description.to:
Outcome: The v1 customisation surface (owner decision 7) as a short first-run flow: site name and tagline, logo upload, colours for light and dark, fonts from the allow-list, sections, nav order, home template, and the subdomain. Every step validates with the shared validator and shows the live preview (PPY-91fb68). Plain buttons and Lucide icons; one Accept/Reject vocabulary.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): app/newsroom (new onboarding route and components/), lib/ validator twin, the site store save mutation, TenantDomain change for the subdomain.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features/tenant-onboarding.feature):
Scenario: A new admin sets up their site in one sitting
    Given a freshly provisioned tenant and its admin signed in
    When she sets the name, uploads a logo, picks colours and a font and renames a section
    Then the preview shows each change and saving publishes them within the TTL

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-91fb68, PPY-e572de, PPY-70a429. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Browser tests at 375, 820 and 1440 px.
Rollout: Shared stack.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: colour choices fail contrast and the user is stuck. Mitigation: the validator suggests the nearest passing colour.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
